description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing a plugin for Playwright that gathers Git commit information and CI environment details, including functions for fetching git logs, diffs, and CI metadata, and integrating this data into the test configuration.

classes.name: TestRunnerPlugin
classes.description: Interface for Playwright test runner plugins.

methods.name: addGitCommitInfoPlugin
methods.description: Adds the git commit info plugin to the full configuration.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs debug messages if DEBUG_GIT_COMMIT_INFO environment variable is set.

methods.name: gitCommitInfoPlugin
methods.description: Creates a plugin object that sets up git and CI info collection during test setup.

methods.name: ciInfo
methods.description: Collects CI environment information based on environment variables for GitHub, GitLab, or Jenkins.

methods.name: gitCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the latest git commit info including hash, author, and branch.

methods.name: gitDiff
methods.description: Computes the diff of uncommitted or specific commits, respecting CI context.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with a timeout and returns the output.
